author: The Wonderful Team
title: Wonderful launches in India
bodyHtml:
Wonderful is launching in India, bringing its applied AI platform and forward-deployed engineering teams to one of the world's largest and most demanding enterprise technology markets.

India is not an early-stage AI market. The country ranks among the world's most advanced markets on AI adoption and awareness. Most large enterprises have run multiple pilots across use cases such as knowledge sharing, operations and productivity, but few have seen them reach enterprise-grade production at scale. Indian enterprises are also among the world's most sophisticated adopters of automation. RPA penetration in India is deeper than in most Western markets, and many organizations are now moving past rules-based automation toward agentic workflows that can reason across systems. 

But the dominant pattern so far has been building in-house, and the results have exposed the gap between a working pilot and a production system: integrations into decades-old core systems, governance and compliance requirements, and the operational work of keeping agents reliable at the scale Indian enterprises operate, often with tens of millions of customers per company. What most enterprises discover is that the constraint isn’t talent — it’s time, and the compounding cost of maintaining AI infrastructure while the underlying technology shifts every few months.

This is the problem Wonderful was built for. Wonderful provides a shared operating layer that allows agents, workflows, applications, context, integrations, and governance to work across the entire organization alongside forward-deployed engineers embedded locally in every market it operates in - teams accountable for getting AI into production in weeks, not quarters, and for transferring capability to the customer's own teams over time. In India, that model addresses the market's specific frictions directly.

The platform is built to work with the systems enterprises actually run. Indian enterprises typically operate a layered stack - modern SaaS alongside legacy core systems that would take years to modernize. Wonderful integrates into that reality as it stands, working across legacy applications without requiring modernization programs as a precondition, and in some cases replacing expensive legacy tooling outright.

The architecture is open by design. Agents, skills, integrations, and governance configurations are exportable and portable. Enterprises building on Wonderful are building their own AI capability, not a dependency on a vendor, and the platform’s model-agnostic approach means enterprises are always getting the best, most efficient model for any given task at any given moment. 

"Indian enterprises have done more AI experimentation than almost any market in the world. What they are asking for now is not another platform demo — it is a partner who will sit inside their environment, co-building with them, integrate with the systems they actually run on, and be accountable for production. That is the entire premise of how Wonderful operates." Bhavik Rathod, Managing Director, Wonderful India

Wonderful operates in more than 35 markets across Europe, LATAM, APAC, and the Middle East, working with over 100 enterprise customers across verticals. Each market has a full-stack local team of forward-deployed engineers and deployment strategists along with go-to-market teams. In India, the team is on the ground and growing, with momentum across financial services, telecom, and retail.

If you are interested in helping build enterprise AI in one of the world's most important technology markets, explore our Careers page and reach out.
